name: @pipeworx/mcp-sec-beneficial-ownership

tools.name: sec_13d_filings
tools.description: List Schedule 13D / 13G beneficial-ownership filings (and their amendments, 13D/A and 13G/A) for one issuer — AUTHORITATIVE source for "who owns 5%+ of $TICKER" and "has an activist filed a 13D on this company". Takes a ticker or company name (auto-resolved to CIK) or a CIK directly. Each row flags `structured: true/false` — filings from SEC's 2024 XML rule onward are structured and feed straight into sec_13d_filing; older ones are plain text/HTML only. Use sec_13d_filing on any accession_number returned here to get the actual reporting-owner data (percent of class, voting power, purpose).

ticker_or_cik.description: Stock ticker ("GME"), company name ("GameStop"), or SEC CIK, of the ISSUER whose beneficial-ownership filings to list.

form_type.description: Filter to one form family. "13D" / "13G" exclude amendments; "13D/A" / "13G/A" are amendments only. Default "all".

tools.name: sec_13d_filing
tools.description: Parse ONE Schedule 13D or 13G filing by issuer + accession_number (get the accession_number from sec_13d_filings). Returns every reporting owner (the "group members") with percent of class, sole/shared voting power, sole/shared dispositive power, and aggregate shares owned; for Schedule 13D, also Item 4 — the free-text "Purpose of Transaction", which is where an activist states its intent (board seats, a merger, liquidation, or "no plans"). Filings from before SEC's 2024 structured-XML rule have no machine-readable fields — this returns `structured: false` plus the bounded plain text of the filing instead of silently returning empty data.

ticker_or_cik.description: Ticker, company name, or CIK of the ISSUER the filing is about (same value you passed to sec_13d_filings).

accession_number.description: The filing's SEC accession number, e.g. "0001104659-25-086308" (dashes optional). From sec_13d_filings.

tools.name: sec_13d_search
tools.description: MARKET-WIDE search of Schedule 13D / 13G beneficial-ownership filings by FILING DATE — no ticker needed. AUTHORITATIVE for "which activist investors filed new 13Ds this month and which companies did they target", "who disclosed a 5%+ stake in anything last week", "new 13G filings since Monday". Returns, per filing: the SUBJECT company (the issuer targeted, with ticker and CIK), the FILERS (investors / reporting persons, with CIK), form, filing date, and whether it is an amendment. By default only NEW filings (amendments excluded; set include_amendments true to add 13D/A and 13G/A). For the first `enrich` structured filings (post-2024 XML rule, default 5, max 10) it also reads the filing itself and adds the reporting owners' percent of class and shares owned, the event date, and — for 13D — the Item 4 "Purpose of Transaction" text (the activist signal). Rows beyond `enrich` carry the index fields only; pass their accession to sec_13d_filing for the full parse. `total_matches` is the true count for the window, `scanned` how many were read (at most 300), and `truncated` says honestly when the window held more than was scanned — narrow the date range rather than assuming completeness. Default window: the last 30 days.

start_date.description: First filing date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days before end_date.

end_date.description: Last filing date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

include_amendments.description: Include 13D/A and 13G/A amendments. Default false (new filings only).

limit.description: Max filings to return (1-100, default 25), newest first.

enrich.description: How many of the returned structured filings to read in full for percent of class and Item 4 purpose (0-10, default 5). Each is one SEC document fetch.

tools.name: sec_13d_amendment_diff
tools.description: Given one 13D/A or 13G/A amendment (issuer + accession_number), find the SAME reporting group's prior filing in the chain and diff what changed: percent of class, aggregate shares owned, sole/shared voting & dispositive power (per reporting owner, matched by CIK or name), and — for 13D — whether the Item 4 purpose text changed. Walks back through the issuer's filing history (bounded, never a bulk crawl) matching on reporting-owner identity, since EDGAR does not carry an explicit "previous accession" link for this form family. Reports `prior_filing_found: false` honestly if no matching prior filing turns up within the scan bound, or if the chain predates the structured-XML rule (diffing free text is not meaningful).

ticker_or_cik.description: Ticker, company name, or CIK of the ISSUER.

accession_number.description: Accession number of the AMENDMENT (13D/A or 13G/A) to diff against its predecessor. Also accepts an original 13D/13G, in which case there is by definition no prior filing.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-sec-beneficial-ownership forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the sec-beneficial-ownership pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
